title: Vorticity confinement for 2D incompressible flows in an infinite cylinder
summary: We study the confinement of vorticity for two-dimensional incompressible flows in an infinite cylinder. For Navier-Stokes solutions with non-negative and compactly supported initial vorticity, we derive quantitative decay estimates showing that the vorticity mass outside regions whose distance from the initial support grows like $\sqrt{t\log^αt}$ (with $α>1$) or like $t^β$ (with $β>1/2$) becomes, respectively, super-polynomially or stretched-exponentially small.
